name: Motorcycle repair

pf.license.need: if: where the state registers repair shops, or certifies mechanics by repair kind (motorcycles count where the state's list says vehicles)
ask: The shop's repair-shop registration number, where the state has one
Each mechanic's certificate for the repair kinds they do, where the state certifies them
A tow driver's license, where the state's rules require one for hauling a motorcycle for hire
pf.license.who: both: the shop, and each person
pf.license.check: the state's license lookup; where there's none, a person on Rosie's team checks within 1 business day
pf.license.blocks: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: garage liability and coverage for customers' motorcycles in the shop's care, as the business says; shown as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.otherwise: identity checked, and 'license: what the business says'

pf.services.pattern: drop-off: the motorcycle is left at the shop and picked up when it's ready

list.name: Diagnosis (warning light, won't start, noise, how it rides)
list.price: one price (the example shop: $95), OK'd in writing on the drop-off page
list.length: a set time, like 1 hour; more time is new work that needs a new yes

list.name: Repair after a diagnosis
list.price: quoted at the visit: a written estimate with the most it can cost, signed before any repair
list.after: at the counter, or the bill Rosie texts with the ready text

list.name: Chain clean, lube and adjust; battery test; headlight bulb swap; flat tire repair
list.price: one price from the shop's board (the example shop: chain service $35)
list.length: 30 to 60 minutes; wait or drop off

list.name: Oil and filter change
list.price: one price from the shop's board
list.length: about 45 minutes; wait or drop off

list.name: Tire change (mount and balance), brake pads, brake fluid
list.price: one price per tire or per axle, from the shop's list

list.name: Scheduled service by miles or hours (plugs, filters, fluids, valve check)
list.price: one price per model, from the shop's list
list.length: about half a day, or the day

list.name: Safety inspection, where the state asks for one
list.price: one price; paid when booking, if the shop sets it

list.name: Winter storage prep and spring start-up
list.price: one price, from the shop's list

list.name: Fairing and body-part replacement
list.price: quoted from photos; the parts are ordered after the deposit (the example: $640, $160 deposit)
list.length: a few days, for the parts

list.name: Tow-in
list.price: the tow's own price, plus the diagnosis
list.place: the motorcycle comes by tow or trailer at any time, keys in the key box

list.name: Mobile repair (brake pads, battery, chain, a motorcycle that won't start)
list.price: one price, quoted from photos and the motorcycle's details, or quoted at the visit
list.place: at the customer's home or work (a garage or a driveway)
list.before: a card saved for the trip fee; nothing else taken
list.after: Rosie texts the bill, or the saved card is charged at DONE

list.name: Pick-up and delivery by trailer
list.price: a flat fee, or free within a set distance
list.place: starts at the customer's door; the work is done at the shop

list.name: Pre-purchase inspection
list.place: at the shop, or where the motorcycle for sale is parked

pf.services.capacity: a daily cap on diagnoses (the example shop: 6 a day); one lift and one mechanic per job; the tire machine is saved like equipment; a weight limit on the lift (the example shop: 1,000 pounds), and trikes and sidecar rigs by appointment
pf.services.sent_now: a motorcycle that won't start, at a home or a workplace, can be sent now in open hours to the mechanic on call; one stopped on a road or in traffic is not sent: the customer is told to call a roadside service
pf.services.drop_off_window: drop-off slots by the shop's daily number (the example shop: 6 motorcycles a day), shown as drop-off times with no mechanic named, plus an after-hours key box once the drop-off page is signed
pf.services.loaners: none: the shop lends no motorcycles
pf.services.shuttle: a free ride home within a set distance and hours (the example shop: 5 miles, 8am to 5pm)
pf.services.warranty: on the receipt, in months or miles, parts and labor (the example: 12 months or 12,000 miles)
pf.services.nobody_home: a mobile job on a parked motorcycle can be done with nobody there: the keys are left as agreed, and DONE comes with a photo

before_times: What is the motorcycle doing, and since when? In the customer's own words
Any warning lights? Steady or flashing?
Can it be ridden in, or does it need a trailer?
For a mobile job: where it's parked, and whether it starts
after_time: Wait, drop off, or a ride home?
OK for the mechanic to take a short test ride? Yes or no
Old parts back? Yes or no
Anything the mechanic should know, like when the noise happens
secure_page_only: Someone else who may say yes to the estimate, named in writing
The key-box code, for an after-hours drop-off
pf.questions.who_may_book: an adult: the motorcycle's owner, or someone the owner lets bring it in; for a teen's motorcycle, a parent books and says yes to prices

stop_words: a fire, or flames from the engine
pf.safety.stop_action: 'Call 911' and the generic emergency steps; no booking
dont_ride_words: a fuel leak or a fuel smell
a front end or wheel that wobbles or shakes
a chain that is broken, jumped or hanging loose
pf.safety.dont_ride_action: Rosie says: park somewhere safe, switch the engine off, and don't ride it. The booking can go on as a tow-in, a trailer pick-up, or a mobile visit.
pf.safety.mobile_stops: a fuel leak, a motorcycle on a slope or a busy street, or no safe place to work: the mechanic stops, and the job moves to the shop

pf.first_steps.required: none before the visit; the diagnosis fee is OK'd in writing on the drop-off page when booking
at_check_in: A recall check on the VIN
The walk-around, the odometer and photos
The test-ride OK, yes or no
prep_for_reminder: Take your helmet, gear and valuables with you; empty the saddlebags
The drop-off window, or the key box after hours
For a mobile job: park on level ground with room to work, and leave the keys as agreed

pf.visit.check_in: a drop-off: the customer gives the check-in code at the counter when leaving the motorcycle. A key-box drop-off or a tow-in has no code: the mechanic texts IN once the motorcycle and keys are found. Mobile: the code at the motorcycle, as at any door.
pf.visit.intake: the odometer, the keys, a walk-around with photos, the problem in the customer's words, old parts back or not, the test-ride OK
pf.visit.recall_check: the VIN is checked for open safety recalls at check-in; an open recall is told to the customer, and its fix is free at the maker's dealers
pf.visit.diagnosis: the OK'd fee covers a set time; more time is new work that needs a new yes; no answer is never a yes
pf.visit.estimate: written, with parts and labor lines, new or used, maker or aftermarket parts, and the most it can cost; signed before any repair
pf.visit.added_work: anything over the signed estimate needs a new yes before it's done, logged with the time, the phone and the new total
pf.visit.ready: READY texts the customer the total, the pick-up hours and any storage terms
pf.visit.pick_up: the motorcycle goes only to the customer, or someone they name; the work and any old parts are shown; the brakes and controls are checked together before it leaves
pf.visit.done_proof: the drop-off code, or IN, checks the motorcycle in; READY and the pick-up close it
pf.visit.late_drop_off: the shop's rule: diagnosed the same day if there's room, or else the next day
pf.visit.pick_up_and_delivery: the driver gets the code at the door with the keys; the motorcycle goes on a trailer, is fixed at the shop and is brought back on a booked return

pf.money.before: the starting answer is nothing taken; the diagnosis fee is OK'd in writing, not charged; a special-order part (a fairing) can take a deposit on a price set before the visit
pf.money.after: paid at the counter at pick-up, the shop's own way; or the bill Rosie texts with the ready text, if the owner turns it on
pf.money.mobile: a card saved for the trip fee, kept only for a late cancel or a no-show; the bill after DONE, or the saved card charged at DONE
pf.money.deposit: a parts deposit only on a price set before the visit; deposit cap: from the state form
pf.money.storage: a daily storage fee only after the free working days that follow the ready text, told before drop-off, and only once the owner confirms it; storage limits: from the state form
pf.money.after_a_no: after a no to the estimate, only the OK'd diagnosis, plus any putting-back-together the state's rules allow
pf.money.fees: no cancel or no-show fee to start at the shop; the mobile trip fee is the late-cancel and no-show fee
pf.money.cancel: free until the cutoff (the example: 24 hours before); a late cancel or a no-show keeps only the trip fee on a mobile visit, and the owner can turn a shop fee on for long jobs
pf.money.tax: the shop's tax rate on parts and labor

never_in_text: A gate or garage door code
pf.messages.minors: texts about a teen's motorcycle go to the parent who booked

pf.staff.licenses: each mechanic's certificate per repair kind, where the state certifies them; a tow driver's license where the state's rules require it
pf.staff.supervision: an apprentice works only while a certified mechanic who may supervise them is on, where the state's rules require it
pf.staff.who_oks: the owner or the service writer OKs estimates, added work, test rides and storage fees
pf.staff.stand_in: only someone certified for that repair kind

pf.rules.written_estimate: switch: a written estimate before work, above an amount: from the state form
pf.rules.written_ok_for_diagnosis: switch: a written OK for the diagnosis fee: from the state form
pf.rules.overage: Rosie's rule: never over the signed estimate without a new yes; no state leeway is used
pf.rules.choose_any_shop: switch: a line saying the customer may pick any shop: from the state form
pf.rules.old_parts: switch: offer the old parts back: from the state form; warranty or core-exchange parts are shown, not given
pf.rules.show_number: switch: the shop's state number on estimates and receipts: from the state form
pf.rules.work_order: switch: what the work order must carry, like the odometer and the problem in the customer's words: from the state form
pf.rules.storage_notice: switch: storage terms told before drop-off, and the free days: from the state form
pf.rules.unclaimed_vehicle: switch: the state's garage-lien and abandoned-vehicle steps; the owner runs them, and Rosie sends only the notices the owner OKs
pf.rules.test_ride: a short test ride only with the customer's yes on the drop-off page; a no means no test ride, and the estimate says so
pf.rules.recalls: the maker's dealers fix open recalls for free; the shop tells the customer and doesn't do the recall work itself

applies: A no-show at drop-off: no fee to start
The motorcycle gets worse before drop-off: the don't-ride steps, then a trailer pick-up or a tow-in
The motorcycle isn't picked up: storage, then written notice
The problem comes back under warranty
pf.edges.handling: each the generic way, with the plug-in's words; the owner confirms every fee

A.other: Others (a bank, a parent, the maker's dealer)

NEW Tue Oct 27 2026 (REDESIGN 2, professions pass P3, batch D2). Built from the refitted auto-repair parent (set "from"); no old flowchart or base plug-in existed, so the plug-in is built from the trade's norm.
Why auto-repair: a motorcycle shop runs like a car shop: a drop-off with a written estimate OK'd before any repair, the VIN recall check, status words, storage after READY, and a mobile mechanic with a trip fee.
Facts dropoff, extrawork, sentnow; no switches; settings A set start (a drop-off time), B 2-hour window, cutoff 24 hours before. No $2 exemption.
Money A (4 paths): visit|none|counter (main: a $95 diagnosis OK'd on the drop-off page, then a signed estimate: $395 fuel system repair + $55 air filter, the $95 inside the $395), list|none|counter ($35 chain service), visit|none|bill, list|none|bill. A photos|deposit path is NOT listed: the master's sign-up card for flow A shows a $20 deposit for it (S1-13), which would disagree with a $160 parts deposit. Money B (4): list|card|bill (main: $179 front brake pad job, $89 trip fee as the late-cancel and no-show fee), visit|card|bill (Leak repair: a fork or oil leak priced at the visit; quote lines fork seals $165 + fork oil $80), list|card|card, photos|deposit|bill ($640 fairing, $160 deposit, $480 rest). No hold, no full price.
Not copied from the parent: loaners (a motorcycle loaner is a big insurance risk) and EPA 609 car A/C work; both gone. A shuttle ride stays. Added: a short test ride only with the customer's yes (pf.questions, pf.rules.test_ride); don't-ride words (soft brakes, fuel leak, smoke, wobble, loose chain, bad tire, flashing engine light); a flat or damaged tire and a loose chain are don't-ride too.
Sent now: a motorcycle that won't start at a home or workplace (S2-30 branch 1 kept, S2-27); one stopped on a road or in traffic is not sent (pf.services.sent_now, pf.safety.mobile_stops). Both B7-55 and B8-58 branches stay (splitsKept B); A8-02 keeps all branches (a missing key can stop the work).
Kinds of work in sign-up: mobile repair + towing (a trailer or flatbed tow, a tow license where the state asks) for Lee Mobile Moto, and the motorcycle shop as the second company. Names under 20 characters (master limit). License numbers are EX-xxxx style. Rename pairs: an extra pair set found by reading the joined flows (service-call fee, mold cleanup company, gas smell stop card, new pipes, yearly flush plan, hair before pricing, a/an before the shop word, a son's motorcycle).
Own steps: A8-x01/x02 recall check, A8-x03 to x05 the diagnosis inside the OK'd hour, A8-x09 a late part. Everything else is master.
Self-checks: (1) sent now stays on, so no opposite claim; loaners and video/phone are off and nothing in the joined text offers them; (2) the example messages avoid the stop words (crash, fire, someone hurt) and use the don't-ride words only as the 'gets worse' examples; (3) B3-11 and B3-18 are one Spanish conversation (white smoke, no flames, switch off and step away).
